evidence.detail: times_from_location blindly takes info['results'][0] from Google Maps Geocoding with no filtering on result type; 'television' or 'ninja' can resolve to a business (type: establishment/point_of_interest) instead of a geographic location
formatted_address returned is also from results[0] unconditionally, confirming no geographic-vs-business filtering exists

triage.fix_sketch: In magic/fetcher.py, in times_from_location, after fetching info['results'], add a step that prefers results whose 'types' list contains a geographic type (e.g. locality, administrative_area_level_1, administrative_area_level_2, country, political) before falling back to results[0]. Assign this preferred result to a local variable and use it for both the geometry/location lookup (line 352) and the formatted_address return (line 365). Change is confined to magic/fetcher.py, ~10–15 lines.
triage.notes: No schema changes, no new dependencies; Google Geocoding already returns a 'types' array per result that makes this filter straightforward.
